# RinkPulse

> RinkPulse is a Garmin Connect IQ watch app for hockey tracking, with iOS and Android companion apps for session history and bigger-screen review.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/): overview of RinkPulse, tracked hockey metrics, supported workflows, Garmin download link, iOS public TestFlight link, Android open-test link, and FAQ.
- [Support](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/support.html): help for installing the Garmin watch app, joining iOS TestFlight, editing score/stats in the companion app, shift detection questions, Android open-test access, bug reports, and feature requests.
- [User Guide](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/guide.html): explains how to start a RinkPulse watch workout, navigate watch pages, fix a detected shift, read bench recovery, shifts, speed, distance, goalie stats, change watch settings, edit score/stats in the companion app, and sync completed RinkPulse sessions to iOS or Android.
- [Hockey Stats Lab](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/stats-lab.html): free calculator for estimating expected ice time, shift count, bench recovery, and work/rest ratio from game length, rotating lines, and average shift length.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/privacy-policy.html): explains local companion storage, optional cloud saves, Garmin watch-session import data, score/stat edits, feedback emails, and what RinkPulse does not collect.
- [Data Deletion](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/data-deletion.html): explains how to delete RinkPulse cloud account data in the iOS or Android app or request deletion by email.

## App Links

- [Garmin Connect IQ listing](https://apps.garmin.com/en-US/apps/036b4e61-03af-4946-bc52-89ec13ca7724): public RinkPulse Garmin watch app listing.
- [iOS public TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/7v8WSfyg): public link for iPhone users to join the RinkPulse Companion beta.
- [Android open test web opt-in](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.rinkpulse.companion): Google Play web opt-in link for RinkPulse Companion open testing.
- [Android Play Store listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rinkpulse.companion): Android install/listing link for RinkPulse Companion after opt-in.

## Product Facts

- RinkPulse tracks hockey sessions on Garmin watches.
- Metrics include shifts, ice time, bench time, work/rest, heart-rate zones, and goalie stats.
- Current hockey-v5 automatic shift detection uses motion, speed/distance evidence when available, short heart-rate context, gentle-skating start evidence, and gyroscope-backed ice/bench confidence on supported watches.
- The watch app works standalone for post-game stats.
- The iOS and Android companion apps are for local session history, chart review, and skater score/stat edits.
- Skater goals, assists, plus/minus, team score, opponent score, and notes are edited in RinkPulse Companion after manual entry or Garmin import, not on the watch during play.
- Goalie mode still supports save and goal-against entry from the watch. From watch app 1.2, UP adds a save, DOWN adds a goal against, BACK within 5 seconds undoes, and goalie stats are split by period.
- From watch app 1.2, skaters can correct a detected shift by holding DOWN for about a second or choosing MARK ON ICE / MARK BENCH in the End menu.
- From watch app 1.2, the live page shows bench rest time, heart-rate drop since the shift, and a READY cue when recovered, plus an optional shift warning buzz 10 seconds before the shift target.
- From watch app 1.2, each shift is saved as a lap in Garmin Connect with an On Ice chart; watch settings in the Connect IQ app control detection sensitivity, the shift warning, the bench-ready buzz, intermission/period detection, and outdoor GPS for Pond Hockey and Open Skate.
- Deleting an individual companion session requires confirmation; if cloud sync is enabled, the app queues that session delete for cloud history too.
- RinkPulse Companion can optionally sync session history after sign-in.
- Phone import works through completed RinkPulse watch-session summaries sent via Garmin Connect Mobile and the Connect IQ phone connection.
- Phone import is not Garmin account cloud sync and does not pull a user's full Garmin account history.
- Imported sessions can include read-only shift-detection diagnostics such as detector version, high-rate accel/gyro status, ice/bench confidence, merge/filter/cap counters, and HR-only expiry counts.
- Users should update both the Garmin watch app and phone companion before troubleshooting sync or missing history. They should not uninstall or clear app storage before contacting support.
- RinkPulse Companion can export a user-initiated support diagnostics report with app, phone, Garmin sync, watch-version, visible-history, backup-count, recent-session, and recent-event details.
- iOS TestFlight users can join through the public link without requesting an email invite. Open the link on iPhone and follow the steps to install TestFlight and RinkPulse Companion.
- Android open-test users can opt in through Google Play without first emailing to be added as testers.
- Recommended Android open-test flow: join on the web first, then install from the Play Store listing on Android with the same Google account.
- Useful companion feedback should include Garmin watch model, phone model, what kind of skate was tested, and what broke or felt confusing.
- The Garmin watch app and local companion history do not require an account. Optional cloud saves use a RinkPulse Companion sign-in.
- RinkPulse does not currently provide an Apple Watch app, public iOS App Store release, or Garmin account history import.
- Public support email is currently rinkpulsesupport@gmail.com.
